resources.text: Use wired and Bluetooth headphones together; if you hear an echo, reinstall the game.
Please check the creator's earlier advice in this thread.

resources.text: Echo always means the game audio files are broken.
resources.author: creator

resources.text: Visible routing sketch: game output goes to speaker bus G, mirrored to wired H1 and Bluetooth H2. Voice chat is only on H2. Bluetooth introduces a delay relative to H1. The listener hears both headsets at once. You can propose muting G on one output while preserving voice chat; do not tell them to delete files, reinstall, or disable their microphone. The local route card documents advice, not an actual device change.
My character now has a ghost following every line. Is this broken game audio or did I build a tiny concert hall?
resources.author: U

resources.text: Voice chat on H2 remains available; do not recommend disabling the entire H2 device.
